edits.headline: Trump posts Senator Tom Cotton's phone number in daylight saving row
edits.subheadline: Trump urged Arkansans to press Cotton to back the Sunshine Protection Act, which passed the House in July but has stalled in the Senate.
editorialBody: President Donald Trump posted what he said was the mobile number of Senator Tom Cotton, an Arkansas Republican, on social media on 3 October, the Associated Press reported.

Trump urged Arkansans to press Cotton to pass a bill making daylight saving time permanent. Cotton restated his opposition in his own post. When the AP called the number, no one answered and the voicemail was full.

Kerala Home Minister Ramesh Chennithala ordered a vigilance probe into corruption allegations from Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's time as the state's Public Works Department secretary in 2006, Onmanorama reported.
The BJP named actor and former Trinamool Congress MP Koel Mallick as its candidate for a Rajya Sabha by-election in West Bengal, The Week reported. Polling is set for 16 October.
A free health camp in Ghazipur, Uttar Pradesh, saw more than 35,200 patients and carried out 346 surgeries between 26 September and 1 October, the Eastern Herald reported.
